description:
FILED s541a (Opus agent, 2026-11-16) from the CPAN board's RUN-PHASE measurement (#4791; docs/cpan-runtime-comparison-s541.md, the per-file table baselines/board-runtime-s541.tsv, the instrument tools/board-timing.pl --run).  Code c1fe4930 (MAIN-READY-97); timings on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3, load < 2), scratch in the s541a worktree scratch/s541a/.

WHAT: %p-proto-index rebuilds by walking *p-declared-subs* whenever *p-sub-table-epoch* moved; a program that alternates `sub` installation and string evals (IO-Compress's constant tests define subs between evals) pays a full walk per eval.  Profile (scratch/s541a/prof-c1fe4930/IO-Compress-2.214-0__111const-deflate.t.cpu.prof): %p-build-proto-index 15 %, %p-proto-index 15 %, %p-sub-bare-name 8 %, %pcl-invert-case 8 %, package-iter-step 7 % of the run (~50 ms of 0.33 s SBCL CPU).  LEVER: update the index incrementally at sub installation (add / replace one entry) instead of a rebuild.  Board seconds small (< 1 s); recorded so the shape is known.  Measurement for whoever takes it: a loop of 500 x (install a prototyped sub; eval "1") with 2,000 prototyped subs defined -- time per eval before / after.
subject: PERF (small): the eval sub table (#2870's %p-proto-index) is rebuilt from ALL defined subs on every string eval when a sub was installed since the last one -- IO-Compress 111const-deflate.t 15 % of its run (%p-build-proto-index, %p-sub-bare-name, %pcl-invert-case)
